description: Collab-workspace lifecycle hooks for Codex CLI. Uses the repo's client-neutral hooks.py dispatcher (invoked with --client=codex so output uses Codex's flat systemMessage schema). 2026-07-28: dropped the COLLAB_WS_DIR=$HOME/.claude/collab overrides — that machine-wide room doesn't exist on this machine, so the hooks pointed nowhere. Codex now uses the repo's default director room (.claude/collab/), the same room .codex/config.toml's MCP entry uses, so a Codex/GPT director sees the same traffic as everyone else. Note: Codex has no blockable Stop hook, so the wake watcher (hooks.py stop) is Claude-only — a Codex director should loop collab_wait instead of relying on being woken.
